title: MedPT: A Massive Medical Question Answering Dataset for Brazilian-Portuguese Speakers

bias_targets.methodology: Characterizing the linguistic properties, natural communication asymmetry, and token distributions of native Brazilian Portuguese patient-doctor interactions to address the English-centric linguistic bias in existing medical AI resources.

Evaluating the thematic diversity and topic distribution of the dataset to ensure representation of region-specific clinical contexts, local health concerns, and endemic diseases (e.g., dengue and Chagas disease) that are often lost in translated datasets.
